# Orra UI component catalog

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build-registry.mjs from apps/docs/registry — do not edit by hand. -->

Every component and template, with its exports and a working example. npm mode imports from `@orra-ui/react`; source mode installs with `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add <slug> --yes`. Props tables: MCP `get_component` or the docs site.

## Base components

### Accordion — `accordion`

可展开的分区列表：单开或多开、平滑的高度动画、可选图标与副标题，提供 bordered 卡片、flush 无边框和 separated 分离三种样式。

- Exports: `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add accordion --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from "@orra-ui/react";

const FAQ = [
  { id: "trial", title: "免费试用包含哪些功能？", body: "14 天内可使用团队版的全部功能，包括无限看板、自动化规则和 PDF 导出，无需绑定银行卡。" },
  { id: "seats", title: "如何按席位计费？", body: "按每月活跃成员计费。仅查看报表的访客不占用席位，可随时在「账单」中增减。" },
  { id: "export", title: "可以导出我的数据吗？", body: "可以。在设置 → 数据中一键导出 CSV 或 JSON，大型工作区会在后台打包后发送下载链接。" },
  { id: "security", title: "数据存放在哪里？", body: "默认存放在华东地区的数据中心，企业版可选择其他区域，并支持私有化部署。" },
];

export default function AccordionOverview() {
  return (
    <Accordion className="max-w-xl" defaultExpandedKeys={["trial"]}>
      {FAQ.map((item) => (
        <AccordionItem key={item.id} id={item.id} title={item.title}>
          {item.body}
        </AccordionItem>
      ))}
    </Accordion>
  );
}
```

### Announcement — `announcement`

产品公告：页面顶部可关闭的通栏横幅，或放在标题上方的紧凑胶囊；包含「新」徽标、消息、链接和关闭按钮。

- Exports: `Announcement`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add announcement --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { RiSparklingLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { Announcement } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function AnnouncementOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full flex-col items-center gap-8">
      <div className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line">
        <Announcement href="#changelog" dismissible>
          智能报表现已支持自然语言提问
        </Announcement>
        <div className="flex h-24 items-center justify-center bg-surface text-body-sm text-fg-subtle">页面内容</div>
      </div>
      <Announcement variant="pill" href="#release" icon={<RiSparklingLine />}>
        Orra 3.0 正式发布：工作流自动化
      </Announcement>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Avatar — `avatar`

用户、团队或机器人的头像：图片加载失败时回退为姓名首字母，底色由姓名稳定生成；支持五种尺寸、在线状态点、方形样式，以及带「+N」溢出的重叠头像组。

- Exports: `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`, `avatarInitials`, `avatarSwatchIndex`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add avatar --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from "@orra-ui/react";

const TEAM = ["林晓雨", "周子航", "Marta Kowalski", "陈思远", "Priya Nair", "王嘉禾", "Tomás Ortega"];

export default function AvatarOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Avatar name="林晓雨" size="lg" status="online" />
        <Avatar name="Marta Kowalski" size="lg" status="away" />
        <Avatar name="周子航" size="lg" status="busy" />
        <Avatar name="Orra 构建机器人" initials="OB" size="lg" square />
        <Avatar size="lg" />
      </div>
      <AvatarGroup max={4}>
        {TEAM.map((name) => (
          <Avatar key={name} name={name} />
        ))}
      </AvatarGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
}
```

### Button — `button`

基于 React Aria 的操作按钮：solid / outline / soft / plain 四种形态 × accent / neutral / danger 三种语气，三种尺寸，支持前后图标、加载状态和链接形态。

- Exports: `Button`, `ButtonLink`, `buttonClass`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add button --yes`

```tsx

import { RiAddLine, RiArrowRightLine, RiDeleteBinLine } from "@remixicon/react";
```

### Button Group — `button-group`

把多个按钮融合成一组：共享边框、仅首尾圆角，尺寸、形态和语气自动传给子按钮；设置 selectionMode 后变为可单选/多选的切换按钮组，支持横向与纵向。

- Exports: `ButtonGroup`, `ButtonGroupItem`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add button-group --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { RiArrowDownSLine, RiDownloadLine, RiFileCopyLine, RiShareLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { Button, ButtonGroup, IconButton } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function ButtonGroupOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5">
      <ButtonGroup aria-label="文档操作">
        <Button startIcon={<RiFileCopyLine />}>复制</Button>
        <Button startIcon={<RiShareLine />}>分享</Button>
        <Button startIcon={<RiDownloadLine />}>下载</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup aria-label="发布" variant="solid" tone="accent">
        <Button>立即发布</Button>
        <IconButton icon={<RiArrowDownSLine />} aria-label="更多发布选项" className="border-s border-fg-on-accent/25" />
      </ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup aria-label="分页" size="sm">
        <Button>上一页</Button>
        <Button>下一页</Button>
      </ButtonGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Carousel — `carousel`

横向卡片轮播：原生滚动吸附、上一张/下一张按钮、分页圆点、可选自动播放与键盘方向键，slideSize 让下一张卡片露出一部分。

- Exports: `Carousel`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add carousel --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { Badge, Carousel } from "@orra-ui/react";

const TEMPLATES = [
  { title: "销售漏斗看板", desc: "按阶段追踪商机转化与预计成交额", tag: "销售", tint: "bg-accent-50" },
  { title: "客户成功周报", desc: "健康分、续约风险与跟进记录一页看完", tag: "客服", tint: "bg-success-soft" },
  { title: "招聘进度追踪", desc: "候选人状态、面试安排与 Offer 审批", tag: "人事", tint: "bg-warning-soft" },
  { title: "产品发布清单", desc: "跨团队的上线检查项与负责人", tag: "产品", tint: "bg-info-soft" },
  { title: "费用报销流程", desc: "自动汇总票据并按部门统计预算", tag: "财务", tint: "bg-danger-soft" },
];

export default function CarouselOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl">
      <Carousel aria-label="精选模板" slideSize="78%" gap={12}>
        {TEMPLATES.map((t) => (
          <article key={t.title} className="flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
            <div className={`h-28 ${t.tint}`} />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-4">
              <Badge size="sm" className="mb-1">
                {t.tag}
              </Badge>
              <span className="text-body font-medium text-fg">{t.title}</span>
              <span className="text-body-sm text-fg-subtle">{t.desc}</span>
            </div>
          </article>
        ))}
      </Carousel>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Checkbox — `checkbox`

复选框：带标签与说明、半选状态、对勾描边动画；CheckboxGroup 提供分组标签与多列布局，variant="card" 变为可选中的卡片。

- Exports: `Checkbox`, `CheckboxGroup`, `CheckboxIndicator`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add checkbox --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function CheckboxOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <Checkbox defaultSelected description="每周一早上 9 点发送上周的数据摘要。">
        订阅周报
      </Checkbox>
      <CheckboxGroup label="通知渠道" defaultValue={["email", "app"]} description="至少保留一个渠道。">
        <Checkbox value="email">邮件</Checkbox>
        <Checkbox value="app">站内信</Checkbox>
        <Checkbox value="sms">短信</Checkbox>
        <Checkbox value="wecom" isDisabled>
          企业微信（未绑定）
        </Checkbox>
      </CheckboxGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Chip — `chip`

可交互的紧凑标签：基于 React Aria TagGroup，支持单选/多选筛选、可移除（收件人）、前置图标或头像，并带键盘方向键导航。

- Exports: `ChipGroup`, `Chip`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add chip --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { Selection } from "react-aria-components";
import { RiFireLine, RiStarLine, RiTimeLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { Chip, ChipGroup } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function ChipOverview() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Selection>(new Set(["hot"]));
  const count = selected === "all" ? 4 : selected.size;
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-3">
      <ChipGroup label="筛选模板" selectionMode="multiple" selectedKeys={selected} onSelectionChange={setSelected}>
        <Chip id="hot" icon={<RiFireLine />}>
          热门
        </Chip>
        <Chip id="new" icon={<RiTimeLine />}>
          最新上架
        </Chip>
        <Chip id="starred" icon={<RiStarLine />}>
          我的收藏
        </Chip>
        <Chip id="free">免费</Chip>
      </ChipGroup>
      <span className="text-caption text-fg-subtle">已选 {count} 个条件</span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Color Picker — `color-picker`

颜色选择器：饱和度/亮度面板、色相滑块、可选透明度滑块、HEX 输入与预设色板；既可内嵌展示，也可通过紧凑的色块触发器在浮层中打开。

- Exports: `ColorPicker`, `ColorPickerPanel`, `COLOR_PICKER_SWATCHES`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add color-picker --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ColorPicker } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function ColorPickerOverview() {
  const [brand, setBrand] = useState("#5B5FEF");
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xs flex-col gap-4">
      <ColorPicker label="品牌主色" value={brand} onChange={(c) => setBrand(c.toString("hex"))} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-control border border-line bg-surface p-3">
        <span className="size-8 rounded-lg" style={{ background: brand }} />
        <span className="text-body-sm text-fg-muted">
          按钮、链接和选中态会使用 <span className="font-mono text-fg">{brand}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Combobox — `combobox`

可输入筛选的选择器：输入关键字实时过滤选项，弹层与 Select 样式一致，支持图标、说明、分组和空状态，字符串子元素可直接作为文本值。

- Exports: `Combobox`, `ComboboxItem`, `ComboboxSection`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add combobox --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { Combobox, ComboboxItem } from "@orra-ui/react";

const CITIES = ["北京", "上海", "广州", "深圳", "杭州", "成都", "武汉", "南京", "西安", "苏州", "重庆", "厦门"];

export default function ComboboxOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Combobox label="办公城市" placeholder="输入城市名筛选" description="支持输入拼音之外的任意关键字。">
        {CITIES.map((city) => (
          <ComboboxItem key={city} id={city}>
            {city}
          </ComboboxItem>
        ))}
      </Combobox>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Command Palette — `command-palette`

⌘K 命令面板：顶部搜索框 + 分组结果（页面、操作、最近访问），条目支持图标、描述、快捷键与同义词搜索，带空状态和按键提示，可配置或关闭全局快捷键。

- Exports: `CommandPalette`, `CommandPaletteGroup`, `CommandPaletteItem`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add command-palette --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  RiAddLine,
  RiBarChartBoxLine,
  RiFileTextLine,
  RiHome5Line,
  RiMoonLine,
  RiSearchLine,
  RiSettings3Line,
  RiTeamLine,
  RiTimeLine,
  RiUserAddLine,
} from "@remixicon/react";
import { Button, CommandPalette, CommandPaletteGroup, CommandPaletteItem, Kbd } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function CommandPaletteOverview() {
  const [last, setLast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
      <CommandPalette
        shortcut={false}
        onAction={(key) => setLast(String(key))}
        trigger={
          <Button variant="outline" tone="neutral" startIcon={<RiSearchLine />} className="w-64 justify-start text-fg-subtle">
            <span className="flex-1 text-start">搜索或执行命令…</span>
            <Kbd keys="mod+k" size="sm" joined />
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <CommandPaletteGroup title="最近访问">
          <CommandPaletteItem id="recent-q4" icon={<RiTimeLine />} description="增长实验室 · 2 小时前">
            Q4 渠道复盘
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="recent-okr" icon={<RiTimeLine />} description="管理层 · 昨天">
            2027 年度 OKR 草案
          </CommandPaletteItem>
        </CommandPaletteGroup>
        <CommandPaletteGroup title="页面">
          <CommandPaletteItem id="home" icon={<RiHome5Line />} keywords={["home", "dashboard", "首页"]}>
            工作台
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="reports" icon={<RiBarChartBoxLine />} keywords={["reports", "analytics"]}>
            数据报表
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="team" icon={<RiTeamLine />} keywords={["team", "members"]}>
            团队成员
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="settings" icon={<RiSettings3Line />} keywords={["settings", "preferences"]} shortcut="mod+,">
            设置
          </CommandPaletteItem>
        </CommandPaletteGroup>
        <CommandPaletteGroup title="操作">
          <CommandPaletteItem id="new-doc" icon={<RiFileTextLine />} shortcut="mod+n" keywords={["new", "create"]}>
            新建文档
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="new-project" icon={<RiAddLine />} keywords={["project"]}>
            新建项目
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="invite" icon={<RiUserAddLine />} description="通过邮箱邀请同事加入工作区" keywords={["invite"]}>
            邀请成员
          </CommandPaletteItem>
          <CommandPaletteItem id="theme" icon={<RiMoonLine />} shortcut="mod+shift+l" keywords={["dark", "theme", "深色"]}>
            切换深色模式
          </CommandPaletteItem>
        </CommandPaletteGroup>
      </CommandPalette>
      <p className="text-body-sm text-fg-subtle">{last ? `已执行：${last}` : "点击按钮打开（本页已占用 ⌘K，因此关闭了全局快捷键）"}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Context Menu — `context-menu`

在任意区域右键、触屏长按或按 Shift+F10 / 菜单键打开的上下文菜单，在指针位置弹出，菜单项能力与下拉菜单一致。

- Exports: `ContextMenu`, `ContextMenuItem`, `ContextMenuSection`, `ContextMenuSeparator`, `ContextMenuSubmenu`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add context-menu --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { RiDeleteBinLine, RiDownloadLine, RiFileCopyLine, RiImageLine, RiPencilLine, RiPriceTag3Line } from "@remixicon/react";
import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuSubmenu } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function ContextMenuOverview() {
  const [last, setLast] = useState("右键、长按或 Shift+F10 打开菜单");
  return (
    <ContextMenu
      aria-label="文件操作"
      onAction={(key) => setLast(`已执行：${String(key)}`)}
      className="flex h-44 w-full max-w-md flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-card border border-dashed border-line-strong bg-surface text-center"
      menu={
        <>
          <ContextMenuItem id="rename" icon={<RiPencilLine />} shortcut="f2">
            重命名
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem id="copy" icon={<RiFileCopyLine />} shortcut="mod+c">
            复制
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuItem id="download" icon={<RiDownloadLine />}>
            下载原图
          </ContextMenuItem>
          <ContextMenuSubmenu label="添加标签" icon={<RiPriceTag3Line />}>
            <ContextMenuItem id="tag-banner">活动横幅</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuItem id="tag-social">社交媒体</ContextMenuItem>
            <ContextMenuItem id="tag-print">印刷物料</ContextMenuItem>
          </ContextMenuSubmenu>
          <ContextMenuSeparator />
          <ContextMenuItem id="delete" icon={<RiDeleteBinLine />} tone="danger" shortcut="delete">
            移到回收站
          </ContextMenuItem>
        </>
      }
    >
      <RiImageLine className="size-8 text-fg-subtle" />
      <p className="text-body font-medium text-fg">双十一主视觉.png</p>
      <p className="text-body-sm text-fg-subtle">{last}</p>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}
```

### Date Calendar — `date-calendar`

内联的月历：单日选择与范围选择两种形态，支持最小 / 最大日期、不可用日期、多月并排，每周起始日随语言环境变化。

- Exports: `DateCalendar`, `DateRangeCalendar`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add date-calendar --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { getLocalTimeZone, today } from "@internationalized/date";
import type { DateValue } from "react-aria-components";
import { DateCalendar } from "@orra-ui/react";
```

### Date Range Picker — `date-range-picker`

- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add date-range-picker --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { getLocalTimeZone, today } from "@internationalized/date";
import type { DateValue } from "react-aria-components";
import { DateRangePicker } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function DateRangePickerOverview() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<{ start: DateValue; end: DateValue } | null>(() => {
    const now = today(getLocalTimeZone());
    return { start: now.subtract({ days: 6 }), end: now };
  });
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-3">
      <DateRangePicker label="报表周期" value={range} onChange={setRange} />
      <p className="text-body-sm text-fg-subtle tabular-nums">
        {range ? `${range.start.toString()} 至 ${range.end.toString()}` : "未选择"}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### File Upload — `file-upload`

文件上传：支持拖拽与点击选择的投放区，自动生成格式和大小提示并校验；文件列表显示类型图标、大小、进度条与成功/失败状态，可删除和重试。上传逻辑由使用方实现。

- Exports: `FileUpload`, `FileDropZone`, `FileUploadList`, `FileUploadItem`, `formatFileSize`, `fileMatchesAccept`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add file-upload --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { FileUpload, type UploadFileItem } from "@orra-ui/react";

const SAMPLE: UploadFileItem[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "2026 Q3 经营复盘.pdf", size: 4_820_000, type: "application/pdf", status: "done" },
  { id: "2", name: "门店客流数据.xlsx", size: 1_240_000, status: "uploading", progress: 46 },
  { id: "3", name: "活动主视觉.png", size: 12_400_000, type: "image/png", status: "error", error: "网络中断，上传失败" },
];

export default function FileUploadOverview() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<UploadFileItem[]>(SAMPLE);
  const seq = useRef(10);

  // Fake upload: advance progress on a timer. In a real app, update from your upload request.
  const simulate = (id: string) => {
    const tick = setInterval(() => {
      setFiles((list) =>
        list.map((f) => {
          if (f.id !== id) return f;
          const progress = Math.min(100, (f.progress ?? 0) + 12 + Math.random() * 18);
          if (progress >= 100) clearInterval(tick);
          return { ...f, progress, status: progress >= 100 ? "done" : "uploading" };
        }),
      );
    }, 400);
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <FileUpload
        label="附件"
        accept={["image/*", ".pdf", ".xlsx", ".csv"]}
        maxSize={20 * 1024 * 1024}
        files={files}
        onFilesAdded={(added) => {
          const items = added.map((file) => ({ id: String(seq.current++), name: file.name, size: file.size, type: file.type, status: "uploading" as const, progress: 0 }));
          setFiles((list) => [...items, ...list]);
          items.forEach((item) => simulate(item.id));
        }}
        onRemove={(id) => setFiles((list) => list.filter((f) => f.id !== id))}
        onRetry={(id) => {
          setFiles((list) => list.map((f) => (f.id === id ? { ...f, status: "uploading", progress: 0 } : f)));
          simulate(id);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Progress } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function ProgressOverview() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(18);
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setInterval(() => setValue((v) => (v >= 100 ? 8 : Math.min(100, v + 7))), 700);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, []);
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <Progress label="上传 季度复盘.mp4" value={value} description={value >= 100 ? "上传完成" : "剩余约 1 分钟"} tone={value >= 100 ? "success" : "accent"} />

    </div>
  );
}
```

### Table — `table`

基于 React Aria Table 的数据表格：可排序列、复选框行选择、吸顶表头、舒适/紧凑两种密度、按列对齐、斑马纹与空状态，并提供成员单元格和状态徽标等辅助组件。

- Exports: `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableColumn`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableCell`, `TableUser`, `TableStatus`, `TableEmptyState`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add table --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { Selection, SortDescriptor } from "react-aria-components";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableColumn, TableHeader, TableRow, TableStatus, TableUser, type BadgeTone } from "@orra-ui/react";

type Member = { id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string; status: "active" | "invited" | "suspended"; seats: number; lastSeen: string };

const MEMBERS: Member[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "林晓雨", email: "xiaoyu.lin@lumen.cn", role: "管理员", status: "active", seats: 12, lastSeen: "刚刚" },
  { id: "2", name: "Marta Kowalski", email: "marta@lumen.cn", role: "编辑", status: "active", seats: 4, lastSeen: "2 小时前" },
  { id: "3", name: "周子航", email: "zihang.zhou@lumen.cn", role: "编辑", status: "invited", seats: 0, lastSeen: "—" },
  { id: "4", name: "Priya Nair", email: "priya@lumen.cn", role: "访客", status: "active", seats: 1, lastSeen: "昨天" },
  { id: "5", name: "王嘉禾", email: "jiahe.wang@lumen.cn", role: "财务", status: "suspended", seats: 2, lastSeen: "3 周前" },
];

const STATUS: Record<Member["status"], { label: string; tone: BadgeTone }> = {
  active: { label: "已激活", tone: "success" },
  invited: { label: "待接受", tone: "warning" },
  suspended: { label: "已停用", tone: "neutral" },
};

export default function TableOverview() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortDescriptor>({ column: "name", direction: "ascending" });
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Selection>(new Set(["2"]));
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const key = sort.column as keyof Member;
    const sorted = [...MEMBERS].sort((a, b) => String(a[key]).localeCompare(String(b[key]), "zh", { numeric: true }));
    return sort.direction === "descending" ? sorted.reverse() : sorted;
  }, [sort]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-3xl">
      <Table aria-label="团队成员" selectionMode="multiple" selectedKeys={selected} onSelectionChange={setSelected} sortDescriptor={sort} onSortChange={setSort}>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableColumn id="name" isRowHeader allowsSorting>
            成员
          </TableColumn>
          <TableColumn id="role" allowsSorting>
            角色
          </TableColumn>
          <TableColumn id="status">状态</TableColumn>
          <TableColumn id="seats" align="end" allowsSorting>
            席位
          </TableColumn>
          <TableColumn id="lastSeen" align="end">
            最近活跃
          </TableColumn>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody items={rows}>
          {(m) => (
            <TableRow id={m.id}>
              <TableCell>
                <TableUser name={m.name} description={m.email} />
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell muted>{m.role}</TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <TableStatus tone={STATUS[m.status].tone}>{STATUS[m.status].label}</TableStatus>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell align="end" numeric>
                {m.seats}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell align="end" muted>
                {m.lastSeen}
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          )}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Tag Group — `tag-group`

- Exports: `TagGroup`, `Tag`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add tag-group --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Tag, TagGroup } from "@orra-ui/react";

export default function TagGroupOverview() {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState([
    { id: "ux", name: "用户研究" },
    { id: "proto", name: "原型设计" },
    { id: "ds", name: "设计系统" },
    { id: "a11y", name: "无障碍" },
  ]);
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <TagGroup
        label="擅长领域"
        description="按 Backspace 删除聚焦的标签。"
        items={tags}
        onRemove={(keys) => setTags((list) => list.filter((t) => !keys.has(t.id)))}
        onAdd={(name) => setTags((list) => (list.some((t) => t.name === name) ? list : [...list, { id: `${Date.now()}`, name }]))}
      >
        {(tag) => <Tag id={tag.id}>{tag.name}</Tag>}
      </TagGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
const TOOLS = [
```

### Agent Thinking — `agent-thinking`

智能体的「思考中」指示器：流光 / 跳点 / 脉冲三种样式，带计时器；可展开查看流式输出的推理过程，收起时显示最新一行预览，结束后变为「已思考 N 秒」。

- Exports: `AgentThinking`, `useAgentElapsed`, `formatAgentDuration`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add agent-thinking --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { AgentThinking } from "@orra-ui/react";

const REASONING = `用户希望重构登录页，先看看现有实现。
LoginForm.tsx 里表单校验和请求逻辑混在一起，约 380 行，状态用了 6 个 useState。
可以拆成三块：表单 UI、校验规则、提交 hook。
第三方登录按钮目前写死在组件里，应该改成配置驱动。
还要保留"记住我"的行为，避免影响现有用户的登录态。
方案确定：先抽出 useLoginSubmit，再迁移校验，最后整理样式。`;

export default function AgentThinkingOverview() {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (shown >= REASONING.length) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setShown((n) => Math.min(REASONING.length, n + 2)), 45);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [shown]);
  const active = shown < REASONING.length;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg">
      <AgentThinking active={active} defaultExpanded>
        {REASONING.slice(0, shown)}
      </AgentThinking>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Composer Attachments — `composer-attachments`

输入框的附件条：图片显示缩略图，文件显示类型图标、名称与大小；支持上传进度、失败重试与移除按钮，新附件以弹出动画出现，超出时横向滚动。

- Exports: `ComposerAttachments`, `ComposerAttachment`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add composer-attachments --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ComposerAttachments, type ComposerAttachmentItem } from "@orra-ui/react";

/** A local, generated "photo" so the demo needs no network. */
function scene(hue: number) {
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 80 80"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="oklch(0.88 0.07 ${hue})"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="oklch(0.62 0.14 ${hue + 40})"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="80" height="80" fill="url(#g)"/><circle cx="57" cy="24" r="9" fill="oklch(0.98 0.02 ${hue})"/><path d="M0 62 26 38l20 18 14-12 20 16v20H0Z" fill="oklch(0.42 0.09 ${hue + 70})" opacity=".75"/></svg>`;
  return `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
}

const INITIAL: ComposerAttachmentItem[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "登录页-当前版本.png", type: "image/png", previewUrl: scene(250) },
  { id: "2", name: "设计稿-暗色.png", type: "image/png", previewUrl: scene(300), status: "uploading", progress: 64 },
  { id: "3", name: "Q3 销售明细.xlsx", size: 284_000 },
  { id: "4", name: "竞品调研纪要.pdf", size: 1_620_000 },
  { id: "5", name: "LoginForm.tsx", size: 12_400, status: "error", error: "文件超过 10 MB 限制" },
];

export default function ComposerAttachmentsOverview() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(INITIAL);
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-3 shadow-card">
      <ComposerAttachments
        items={items}
        onRemove={(id) => setItems((list) => list.filter((i) => i.id !== id))}
        onRetry={(id) => setItems((list) => list.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, status: "done", error: undefined } : i)))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Composer Panel — `composer-panel`

- Exports: `ComposerPanel`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add composer-panel --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { RiGlobalLine, RiPlugLine } from "@remixicon/react";
import { ComposerPanel, ModelPicker, type ComposerAttachmentItem, type ModelOption } from "@orra-ui/react";

const MODELS: ModelOption[] = [
  { id: "lumen-4-pro", name: "Lumen 4 Pro", provider: "Lumen", description: "复杂推理与多步骤任务", capabilities: ["reasoning", "vision"] },
  { id: "lumen-4-flash", name: "Lumen 4 Flash", provider: "Lumen", description: "快速问答", capabilities: ["fast"] },
  { id: "cobalt-r2", name: "Cobalt R2", provider: "Cobalt", description: "代码审查", capabilities: ["reasoning", "code"] },
];

export default function ComposerPanelOverview() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<ComposerAttachmentItem[]>([{ id: "spec", name: "登录页需求 v2.pdf", size: 842_000 }]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setLoading(false), 4000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [loading]);

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-2xl flex-col gap-3">
      {sent ? <p className="self-end rounded-card bg-surface-muted px-4 py-2.5 text-body text-fg">{sent}</p> : null}
      <ComposerPanel
        defaultValue="按照需求文档重构登录页，保留“记住我”功能"
        attachments={files}
        onRemoveAttachment={(id) => setFiles((f) => f.filter((x) => x.id !== id))}
        onFilesSelected={(picked) => setFiles((f) => [...f, ...picked.map((p) => ({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), name: p.name, size: p.size, type: p.type }))])}
        addActions={[
          { id: "web", label: "联网搜索", icon: <RiGlobalLine />, description: "检索最新的网页信息" },
          { id: "mcp", label: "连接器", icon: <RiPlugLine />, description: "GitHub、Linear、飞书文档" },
        ]}
        modelPicker={<ModelPicker models={MODELS} variant="ghost" size="sm" />}
        onVoice={() => setRecording((r) => !r)}
        isRecording={recording}
        loading={loading}
        loadingLabel="正在重构登录页…"
        onStop={() => setLoading(false)}
        onSubmit={({ text }) => {
          setSent(text);
          setFiles([]);
          setLoading(true);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Task List — `task-list`

流式任务清单：任务逐条上浮出现，进行中的任务文字流光，完成时勾选线条画出并划掉文字；全部完成后可折叠为一行「已完成 N 项任务」。

- Exports: `TaskList`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add task-list --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { TaskList, type TaskStatus } from "@orra-ui/react";

const TASKS = ["读取现有登录页代码", "抽出表单校验规则", "拆分 useLoginSubmit hook", "第三方登录改为配置驱动", "补充单元测试", "运行测试并修复失败用例"];

export default function TaskListOverview() {
  // tick 0..n: tasks appear, then complete one by one.
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tick >= TASKS.length + 1) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setTick((t) => t + 1), tick === 0 ? 900 : 1300);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [tick]);

  const status = (i: number): TaskStatus => (i < tick - 1 ? "done" : i === tick - 1 ? "working" : "pending");

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5 shadow-card">
      <TaskList title="重构登录页" items={TASKS.map((label, i) => ({ id: String(i), label, status: tick === 0 ? "pending" : status(i) }))} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { WebSearch, type WebSearchQuery, type WebSearchSource, type WebSearchStatus } from "@orra-ui/react";

const QUERIES: WebSearchQuery[] = [
  { id: "q1", query: "AI 编程助手 团队版 定价 2026", resultCount: 38 },
  { id: "q2", query: "Nimbus 席位计费 变更", resultCount: 12 },
];
const SOURCES: WebSearchSource[] = [
  { id: "s1", title: "Nimbus 团队版价格与功能说明", url: "https://nimbus.example.com/pricing" },
  { id: "s2", title: "2026 年开发者工具订阅调查报告", url: "https://devsurvey.example.org/2026" },
  { id: "s3", title: "Kitewise 宣布按用量计费", url: "https://blog.kitewise.example.net/usage-pricing" },
  { id: "s4", title: "如何为 AI 产品定价：五种常见模型", url: "https://pm-notes.example.cn/ai-pricing" },
];

// [phase, visible queries, visible sources, reading index]
const TIMELINE: [WebSearchStatus, number, number, number][] = [
  ["searching", 1, 0, -1],
  ["searching", 2, 0, -1],
  ["reading", 2, 2, 1],
  ["reading", 2, 4, 3],
  ["summarizing", 2, 4, -1],
  ["done", 2, 4, -1],
];

export default function WebSearchOverview() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step >= TIMELINE.length - 1) return;
    const id = window.setTimeout(() => setStep((s) => s + 1), 1300);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(id);
  }, [step]);
  const [status, q, s, reading] = TIMELINE[step]!;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg">
      <WebSearch
        status={status}
        isExpanded
        queries={QUERIES.slice(0, q).map((x, i) => ({ ...x, status: status === "searching" && i === q - 1 ? "running" : "done" }))}
        sources={SOURCES.slice(0, s).map((x, i) => ({ ...x, status: i === reading ? "reading" : "read", citation: status === "done" && i < 3 ? i + 1 : undefined }))}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Auth Card — `auth-card`

登录 / 注册卡片：Logo、标题、第三方登录按钮、分隔线、邮箱与密码表单、条款说明，以及一次性验证码步骤；可在登录、注册、找回密码、验证码之间自动切换，也可受控。

- Exports: `AuthCard`, `type AuthCardValues`, `type AuthCardMode`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add auth-card --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { RiSparkling2Fill } from "@remixicon/react";
import { AuthCard } from "@orra-ui/react";

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function Logo() {
  return (
    <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-[14px] bg-accent-gradient text-fg-on-accent shadow-accent">
      <RiSparkling2Fill className="size-6" />
    </span>
  );
}

export default function AuthCardOverview() {
  return (
    <AuthCard
      logo={<Logo />}
      providers={["google", "github"]}
      onSubmit={async ({ email, password }) => {
        await wait(900);
        if (password !== "orra2026") throw new Error(`${email} 的密码不正确（试试 orra2026）`);
      }}
      onSocial={() => wait(1200)}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
  { id: "7", title: "客户回访", start: "2026-11-12T11:00", end: "2026-11-12T12:00", calendarId: "market" },
```

### Chart Card — `chart-card`

所有图表共用的卡片外壳：标题、描述、主数值与变化徽标、时间范围选择（分段或下拉）、图例、页脚、加载与空状态；同时导出统一的提示框、图例、坐标轴样式、颜色与数字格式工具。

- Exports: `ChartCard`, `ChartRangeSelector`, `ChartDeltaBadge`, `ChartLegend`, `ChartTooltipContent`, `ChartTooltipPanel`, `ChartEmptyState`, `ChartSkeleton`, `useChartCardRange`, `useChartFormatter`, `chartColor`, `chartAxisProps`, `chartGridProps`
- Install (source): `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add chart-card --yes`

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { AreaChart, ChartCard } from "@orra-ui/react";

const RANGES = [
  { id: "7d", label: "7 天" },
  { id: "30d", label: "30 天" },
  { id: "90d", label: "90 天" },
];

function build(days: number, base: number) {
  const count = days > 30 ? 13 : days > 7 ? 15 : 7;
  const step = Math.round(days / count);
  return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const day = new Date(2026, 9, 31 - (count - 1 - i) * step);
    const wave = Math.sin(i / 1.7) * 0.08 + i * 0.018;
    return {
      date: `${day.getMonth() + 1}/${day.getDate()}`,
      revenue: Math.round(base * (1 + wave)),
      previous: Math.round(base * 0.88 * (1 + Math.cos(i / 2.1) * 0.05 + i * 0.01)),
    };
  });
}

const DATA: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof build>> = {
  "7d": build(7, 16800),
  "30d": build(30, 15400),
  "90d": build(90, 14100),
};

const SUMMARY: Record<string, { value: string; delta: number }> = {
  "7d": { value: "¥124,860", delta: 0.086 },
  "30d": { value: "¥482,190", delta: 0.124 },
  "90d": { value: "¥1,386,400", delta: -0.031 },
};

export default function ChartCardOverview() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState("30d");
  const summary = SUMMARY[range]!;
  return (
    <ChartCard
      className="w-full max-w-2xl"
      title="营收"
      description="已完成订单的含税金额"
      ranges={RANGES}
      range={range}
      onRangeChange={setRange}
      value={summary.value}
      delta={summary.delta}
      deltaLabel="较上一周期"
    >
      <AreaChart
        data={DATA[range]}
        index="date"
        valueFormat="currency"
        currency="CNY"
        series={[
          { key: "revenue", label: "本期" },
          { key: "previous", label: "上一周期", comparison: true },
        ]}
      />
    </ChartCard>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { ChartDeltaBadge, Sparkline } from "@orra-ui/react";

const TILES = [
  { label: "营收", value: "¥482,190", delta: 0.124, data: [31, 34, 33, 38, 41, 39, 44, 47, 46, 52] },
  { label: "活跃用户", value: "12,480", delta: 0.061, data: [102, 104, 101, 108, 112, 110, 115, 117, 121, 125], variant: "area" as const },
  { label: "流失率", value: "2.4%", delta: -0.08, data: [3.1, 3.0, 3.2, 2.9, 2.8, 2.9, 2.7, 2.6, 2.5, 2.4], invert: true },
  { label: "工单数", value: "1,205", delta: 0.034, data: [168, 182, 175, 196, 188, 172, 204, 211, 197, 214], variant: "bar" as const },
];

export default function SparklineOverview() {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-2xl gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
      {TILES.map((t) => (
        <div key={t.label} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 shadow-card">
          <span className="text-body-sm text-fg-muted">{t.label}</span>
          <span className="text-title font-semibold tabular-nums text-fg">{t.value}</span>
          <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2">
            <ChartDeltaBadge value={t.delta} invert={t.invert} size="sm" />
            <Sparkline data={t.data} variant={t.variant} width={88} height={30} color={t.invert ? "var(--color-chart-4)" : undefined} />
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Templates

### AI Chat — `ai-chat`

AI 编程助手：左侧按项目与日期分组的对话列表，消息里展示思考过程、执行计划、测试用例清单与代码块，右侧是可拖拽调宽的代码改动面板（文件列表 + 增删行对比）；底部输入框带附件与模型选择，点击发送会模拟智能体完整的工作流程，可重新演示。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add ai-chat --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

### AI Image Generation — `ai-image-generation`

AI 图像生成：每轮对话是一次生成，从进度和逐渐清晰的预览过渡到四宫格结果，支持变体、放大、下载与收藏；输入框内可设置比例、风格、数量与创意度，右侧作品库按类型筛选、搜索并支持设为参考图。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add ai-image-generation --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

### AI Profile — `ai-profile`

开发者的 AI 使用档案：头像与简介、常用语言与成就、四项核心指标、全年使用热力图、可切换范围的 Token 用量堆叠面积图、模型分布环形图、常用项目排行、本月额度，以及最近编程会话表格。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add ai-profile --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

### Calendar — `calendar`

完整的日程页：基于 EventCalendar 的月 / 周 / 列表视图，侧栏包含与主日历联动的迷你月历、日历分类开关和「接下来」列表；新建日程对话框支持选择日历、日期、全天与起止时间，事件浮层可删除。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add calendar --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

### Finance Dashboard — `finance`

财务中心：账户余额与现金跑道、收入支出对比、现金流桑基图、支出构成环形图、部门预算仪表，以及可按收支类型、分类和关键词筛选的交易明细表。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add finance --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

### Home Dashboard — `dashboard`

公司经营首页：KPI 指标卡、营收趋势与渠道占比、最近订单表、团队动态、季度目标进度、热销商品与区域订单。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add dashboard --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

### HR Management — `hr`

人力概览：在职人数、入职与离职率指标，招聘管道、团队分布、敬业度雷达、人员流动、新入职引导进度，以及可按部门筛选的员工名册。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add hr --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)

个人健康档案页：患者信息卡、带迷你趋势图的生命体征、活动三环、睡眠评分仪表、每周步数对比柱状图、今日用药打卡、近期预约、可忽略的健康提醒，以及可切换报告的检验结果表格。

多智能体协作：多位 AI 成员在群聊中分工与交接任务，消息中展示联网调研轨迹、运行记录、任务清单和交付物；右侧成员面板显示每位智能体的角色、模型、工具与实时状态，并可通过对话框添加新的智能体。

- Install: `npx -y @orra-ui/cli add project-board --yes` (copies the page and its template-only parts; needs `@orra-ui/react`)
